text:
riley: FYI we have tenant_attr_index migration tonight 01:15 UTC. tagging @anika @diego @sst-oncall. deploy-bot scheduled. rehearsal showed transient lock storms during fill.

anika: ack. what's the concrete abort/hold criteria?

riley: Abort if replica_lag > 14s OR any pg_lock wait > 9s for > 45s. If aborted: pin schema to v20251109_07 and disable feature flag tenants.attr_index_live. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/attr-index-swap (escape hatch steps included).

diego: Writers: let's do a 90s write-freeze around the swap. Who flips it?

anika: I will flip. API: `POST /internal/flags {"flag":"tenants.attr_index_swap","on":true}` at -3m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled migration 'tenant_attr_index_swap' for 2025-11-15T01:15Z. Canary plan: 4% -> 25% -> 100% with automated canary gates.

ops-runbooks: Preflight: confirm replica sync <6s, WAL backlog <30s, sample backfill size. Escape: abort canary, pin schema, restart writers if WAL backlog >45s, notify SRE pager.

riley: Quick estimate SQL: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_attrs WHERE needs_new_index LIMIT 1;
-- sample: 78_900
```

anika: canary started routing 4%. initial health: latency +2ms, 5xx 0.05%.

sst-oncall: watching replica_lag and lock_wait. thresholds: warn @8s lag, escalate @12s.

diego: queued background job tenant_attr_fill but will pause on lock pressure.

anika: flip flag at 01:12 :white_check_mark:.

sst-oncall: replica_lag creeping 5s -> 9s -> 13s in 7m. approaching warning.

riley: reduce canary to 1% and pause tenant_attr_fill. set safemode `db.lock_timeout=2200ms` in canary region.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reduced canary to 1% and paused job 'tenant_attr_fill'.

diego: if lock_wait spikes, i'll trigger `deploy-bot hold` with reason `lock_wave`. Who runs the pin on abort?

anika: i'll run the pin. SQL to pin: ```sql
UPDATE schema_versions SET active=false WHERE name='tenant_attr_index_swap';
INSERT INTO schema_versions(name, active) VALUES('v20251109_07', true);
```

ops-runbooks: Escape hatch condensed: 1) `deploy-bot abort` 2) pin schema_version 3) flip off tenants.attr_index_swap 4) drop partial index if created `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS tmp_attr_idx` 5) wait for WAL catch-up then restart writers. Manual resume requires ops signoff.

sst-oncall: canary metrics stable at 1% for 10m: latency +1ms, 5xx 0. No WAL backlog growth.

riley: decision: continue 1% for another 10m then advance to 25% if stable. Escalate if lag > 16s or any sustained lock > 12s. Rollback if user errors >0.4% or 5xx spike.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary completed at 01:28 UTC with no abort. advancing to wave2 (25%).

diego: I'll monitor wave2 and stand by for manual pin sql if needed.

anika: adding to release notes: "tenant_attr_index: phased canary, short write-freeze, background fill pauses on contention."

riley: thanks team  keeping watch for wave2 stability. Will call abort if thresholds breach. :thumbsup:
